html:
Containers are objects created to hold things in them. In Tibia, there are three types of containers: Item Containers, Fluid Containers and "Other" Containers. As their names indicate, an Item Container can only hold Items, and thus have a property called Volume which is the number of items it can hold, while Liquid Containers can only hold one sample of a given Liquid (regardless of how small or big it looks like). The Other Containers are Objects which look like Containers but do not have Volume (such as quest Chests) and/or can't have their Liquid content changed, like big Casks.

Item Containers

Item containers have different capacities. Some containers can hold 20 items (Backpack), while other containers may only be able to hold 5 items (Present Box).

Some item containers can be carried in your backpack. Other item containers cannot. If you try to pick up a container that cannot be carried, you will see a message that says "you cannot take this item".

Gold Pouch The Gold Pouch is a special container that you can have in Your Store Inbox. It can only hold Gold, Platinum and Crystal coins, but it has infinite slots. It can be useful for players that struggle with having to carry a lot of empty containers to acommodate the coins picked up from loot, but because of its high cost it can take a long time to pay itself when compared to not picking up the money, specially gold.

It's important to note that the coins in the Gold Pouch are still counted in the character's capacity, so in that regard it only helps that you save the additional weight of other containers.

Your Inbox 32 Inboxes contain all Letters and Parcels that are mailed to a character in a town and items purchased or taken from the Market.
Your Store Inbox 32 The Store Inbox is the storage space dedicated to all items purchased through the Store. After purchase, players can choose to move their purchased items to various locations such as their House, Depot, Inbox, and Store Inbox. While there is no storage limit, only 32 items can be viewed at a time due to display limitations, however like with your Depot Box you have the ability to switch between pages through the use of the arrows at the bottom of the widget.

The Store Inbox's widget allows you click to sort your inbox using the parameters seen in the example photo.

Fluid Containers

Fluid containers do not have an explicit capacity. They are either empty or they have a liquid in them.

Some liquid containers allow you to see the liquid that is inside them (Vial, Bucket, Trough, etc.), but some liquid containers do not change appearance when they have a liquid in them (Bottle, Brown Flask, Cup, etc).

Gold Pouch The Gold Pouch is a special container that you can have in Your Store Inbox. It can only hold Gold, Platinum and Crystal coins, but it has infinite slots. It can be useful for players that struggle with having to carry a lot of empty containers to acommodate the coins picked up from loot, but because of its high cost it can take a long time to pay itself when compared to not picking up the money, specially gold.
